title: Single Source of Truth (SST) for a recuperative care referral
description: One shared, structured record built from a hospital referral packet. Every clinical field is wrapped: value + status + evidence + who last changed it. Unknown is unknown; nothing defaults to normal. Contains no names, dates of birth, record numbers or addresses.

x-status_meaning.pending: Nobody has looked yet. The blank SST starts here.
x-status_meaning.found: Read from the packet. Evidence lists the page(s) and quote.
x-status_meaning.entered: Typed in by a party (hospital, patient or provider), not read from the packet.
x-status_meaning.confirmed: A person checked an extracted value and confirmed it.
x-status_meaning.not_in_packet: Looked for it; the packet does not contain it. Unknown, never 'normal'.
x-status_meaning.redacted: The packet has the field but it is blacked out for privacy (names, dates). Not a missing document.
x-status_meaning.cant_tell: Information is present but not enough to answer (needs a date or hours, or is illegible).
x-status_meaning.conflict: Two places in the packet disagree. Both are listed under conflicts; a person decides.

doc_3_authorization.description: CalOptima / CalAIM authorization form, LOA or auth present

doc_6_vitals_last_24h.description: Vital signs from the last 24 hours present

doc_9_cultures.description: Blood or wound culture results present (if an infection is involved)

doc_10_meds_30_day_supply.description: 30-day supply of all medications arranged (usually confirmed by the hospital, rarely in the packet)

documents.description: The referral checklist from IHH's form (DOC-1 to DOC-10): is each document in the packet, and on which pages.

referring_facility.description: Hospital name. Redacted in the event packets.

referrer_role.description: Case manager, social worker or nurse who sent it

source_setting.description: Where the patient is being referred from. Several rules only apply to inpatient or only to the emergency department.

chief_complaint_or_admitting_dx.description: Why the patient is in hospital, as written

admit_date.description: Admission date. Redacted in the event packets, so hour-based rules are cant_tell.

anticipated_discharge_date.description: When the hospital expects to discharge

length_of_stay_authorized_days.description: Days authorized, from the referral form

authorization_status.description: Status of the health plan authorization for recuperative care

sent_to_other_providers.description: Whether the hospital also referred to other recuperative care providers

referral.description: Facts about the referral itself: who sent it, why the patient is in hospital, insurance and authorization, and where the patient is coming from (inpatient vs emergency department changes several rules).

age_years.description: Age in years. Charts sometimes disagree page to page; record a conflict.

preferred_language.description: Preferred language. Drives the patient view's language.

four_plus_homeless_episodes_3y.description: Referral form: 4+ episodes of homelessness in the past 3 years

patient.description: Non-identifying facts about the person. No names, dates of birth, record numbers or addresses are ever stored here.

too_ill_to_recover_outside.description: Too ill or frail to recover on the street or in a shelter, as a clinician states it about this patient (a form's eligibility wording does not count)

lives_alone_no_supports.description: Lives alone with no formal supports

readmission_risk.description: At risk of hospitalization or re-hospitalization

housing.description: Why recuperative care is being requested (IHH general criteria GEN-1 to GEN-3).

bathing.description: Bathing / showering. A seated shower done alone counts as independent.

gathers_supplies_and_transfers_to_shower.description: Can gather own supplies and get to the shower alone

can_empty_catheter_bag.description: Can empty the catheter bag alone

self_catheterizes.description: Intermittent catheterization done by the patient (eligible) vs by staff (not eligible)

ambulation_distance_ft.description: Farthest documented walking distance in feet (PT note). Rest breaks are fine.

ambulation_assist_level.description: Assistance level for walking, as PT writes it

dme_type.description: Equipment used: walker, cane, wheelchair, shower bench

wheelchair_dependent.description: Relies on a wheelchair. Eligible if transfers are independent (outline wins over the form).

transfers_independent.description: Bed to chair and similar transfers done alone

pt_ot_recommendation.description: Where PT/OT recommends discharge to (home, SNF, acute rehab)

function.description: What the person can do for themselves: daily living activities, continence, mobility and transfers.

orientation.description: Alert and oriented level, latest documented

cognitive_impairment.description: Dementia, Alzheimer's or other cognitive impairment documented

can_self_administer_insulin.description: Gives own insulin (must be confirmed when on insulin)

understands_glucometer.description: Knows how to check own blood sugar

cognition.description: Orientation and the ability to manage one's own medications and learn.

conservatorship_or_fsp.description: Under, qualifies for, or history of conservatorship or Full Service Partnership

aggressive_toward_staff_or_patients.description: Verbal or physical aggression toward staff or other patients documented during this stay. A danger-to-others hold or threats toward family before admission are not this; leave cant_tell and note them for a person to judge

psychiatry_consult_present.description: A psychiatry consult is in the packet

mental_health.description: Psychiatric stability and the behaviours IHH cannot accept.

hours_since_intoxication_admission.description: Hours held since admission. cant_tell when dates are redacted.

detox_noncompliance_or_refusal_to_abstai.description: Form exclusion: non-compliance with detox or refusal to abstain

active_substances.description: Substances in active use, as written

substance_use.description: Alcohol and drug facts that the admission rules turn on.

registered_sex_offender.description: Registered sex offender. Case by case; never auto-deny.

offense_involved_violence.description: If a registered offender, whether the offense involved violence

safety_legal.description: Registered sex offender status, handled case by case under IHH's rules.

mrsa_swab_result.description: MRSA nasal swab result (needed if coming from inpatient)

covid_test_within_24h_of_admission.description: Whether the swab is within 24 hours of arrival. Usually cant_tell before an admission date is set.

tb_screen_result.description: PPD / TB test or chest X-ray screen for TB

active_infection_cleared_by_physician.description: A doctor has documented the infection as cleared or not contagious

infection_control.description: Swabs, isolation and the infections that block admission until cleared.

list_present.description: A medication list is in the packet

high_risk_categories.description: Present categories: insulin, anticoagulant, opioid, iv_antibiotic, chemotherapy, controlled_substance, oxygen

insulin_started_less_than_24h_before_adm.description: Insulin regimen started under 24 hours before recuperative care admission. Usually cant_tell.

iv_medications_ongoing_at_discharge.description: Will still need IV medication after discharge

iv_antihypertensive_last_24h.description: IV blood pressure medication in the last 24 hours

thirty_day_supply_arranged.description: 30-day supply will come with the patient

medications.description: The medication list and the medication facts the rules ask about.

iv_access.description: IV access the patient will leave with

oxygen_continuous.description: Continuous (not eligible for COPD on continuous O2) vs as needed

baseline_spo2_room_air.description: Usual oxygen saturation on room air

lines_devices_oxygen.description: IV lines, oxygen, breathing devices, catheters, dialysis and fixation devices.

patient_independent_with_wound_care.description: Referral form: independent with wound care

wounds.description: Every wound, with the details IHH's wound rules need.

sets.description: Most recent sets of vital signs, newest first

set_count.description: How many sets are in the packet (rules ask for 5)

sepsis_signs.description: Continued fever, fast heart rate or low blood pressure

bp_stable_on_oral_meds_24h.description: Blood pressure stable on oral medication for at least 24 hours

spo2_stable_at_baseline.description: Oxygen readings stable and at the patient's normal

vitals.description: The last sets of vital signs and what they show.

glucose_reading_count.description: How many consecutive readings are in the packet (rule asks for 5)

hypoglycemia_last_week.description: Any hypoglycemia episode in the last week

dka_status.description: Diabetic ketoacidosis. Rules do not say whether resolved DKA still excludes: show the gap.

troponin_count.description: Number of troponin results (rule asks for 3, with 2 negative)

cultures.description: Blood, wound, urine cultures and results

hemoglobin_hematocrit_normal.description: Post cardiac surgery: normal hemoglobin and hematocrit

labs.description: Glucose, troponin, cultures and the few other labs the rules name.

chest_imaging_present.description: Chest X-ray, CT or MRI in the packet

ejection_fraction_percent.description: EF from echo or cath report

ef_is_patient_baseline.description: Low EF established as the patient's baseline

atrial_fibrillation.description: History or new diagnosis of atrial fibrillation

imaging_cardiac.description: Chest imaging, EKG and heart function.

problem_list.description: Active problems, each tagged to a body system and the rule IDs it touches

immediately_post_neurosurgery.description: Just had neurosurgery (escalate for clinical review)

open_fracture.description: Open fracture (not eligible); closed fractures are eligible

jaw_wired.description: Facial fracture with jaw wiring (not eligible)

decompensated_cirrhosis.description: Ascites, varices, encephalopathy or jaundice (not eligible)

recent_heart_attack.description: Being discharged after a heart attack (needs normal EF)

hypertension_uncontrolled_or_symptomatic.description: Hypertension needing IV meds, symptomatic, or not responding to oral meds

respiratory_illness.description: Pneumonia, COPD, asthma, bronchitis or similar

cardiac_condition.description: A cardiac reason for the stay

conditions.description: Diagnoses and the condition flags that map onto IHH's eligible and ineligible lists by body system.

pcp_followup_within_7_days.description: Primary care follow-up scheduled within 5 to 7 days (ED referrals)

written_glucose_treatment_plan.description: Sliding scale or hold parameters written down

on_iv_antibiotics.description: IV antibiotics at discharge (needs home health)

anticoag_independent_and_understands_inr.description: Takes anticoagulant alone and understands INR checks

disease_specific.description: The extra questions IHH asks for diabetes, infection, respiratory and cardiac cases.

home_health_status.description: Home health. The rules use four different thresholds; record the strongest one documented.

home_health_purpose.description: What home health is for: IV, wound care, therapy

wound_care_scheduled.description: Wound care visits scheduled, matching dressing frequency

hospice_arranged.description: Hospice agency arranged and everyone told staff cannot give medications

specialty_followups.description: Booked follow-ups: suture removal, catheter removal, cardiac surgery clinic

oxygen_ordered_tank_ready_day_before.description: Hospital ordered O2 and the tank will be at the site the day before

arrangements.description: Things that must be set up before the person arrives: home health, wound care, therapy, hospice, follow-up visits, oxygen delivery.

present.description: IHH referral form is in the packet

form_code.description: Form code printed on it, for example RC0725-SH

referrer_contact_filled.description: Phone or email filled in (the values are never stored)

patient_identifiers_complete.description: Name, MRN, DOB and insurance all filled in (values never stored)

four_plus_episodes_3y.description: Form: 4+ episodes of homelessness in 3 years

chief_complaint.description: Chief complaint or admitting diagnosis, as written on the form

admit_date_filled.description: Admit date filled in (redacted in event packets)

wounds_description.description: Number, location, size and stage, as written

home_health_will_be_ordered.description: Form: home health will be ordered

tb_test_type.description: Form: PPD/TB test or chest X-ray

tb_result.description: Form: TB result as written (date never stored)

continent.description: Form yes/no: continent of bowel and bladder

limitations_or_challenges.description: Behavioral section: limitations or challenges, as written

length_of_stay_authorized_days.description: Form: length of stay authorized, in days

staff_section_completed.description: IHH staff-only section filled in (blank in all event packets)

present.description: CalAIM / CalOptima authorization form, LOA or auth is in the packet

community_support_requested.description: Which Community Support is requested, as written (recuperative care expected)

requested_start_date_filled.description: Start date filled in (redacted in event packets)

status.description: Authorization status as far as the packet shows

forms.description: The forms inside the packet as written: IHH's referral form and the CalAIM authorization form. Kept separate from the chart sections so the record can show where the form and the chart disagree, and so a filled electronic form can be generated from the SST.

source.description: packet = a page of the referral packet; transcript = a recorded coordination conversation; entered = typed by a party; external = another uploaded document

page.description: 1-based page number in the packet PDF. Required when source is packet; null otherwise

doc_type.description: What kind of page: referral_form, face_sheet, h_and_p, progress_note, pt_ot_eval, nursing_note, mar, labs, imaging, ekg, auth_form, fax_cover, social_work_note, consult, other

ref.description: For transcript or external sources: the conversation id or document id

timestamp.description: For transcript sources: position in the conversation, for example 00:04:12

quote.description: Short verbatim text from the page or transcript that supports the value. Never paraphrase into a quote.

Evidence.description: Where a value came from. Every 'found' value needs at least one.

value.description: The value this page supports, as text

Conflict.description: A second source that disagrees with the recorded value.

size.description: As written, for example 3 x 2 x 0.5 cm

hard_to_reach_area.description: Coccyx, sacrum, back, back of thighs, perineum: needs at least one wound-care visit (INT-E2)

complicated_large_abscess.description: Undefined in the rules; flag for the coordinator

label.description: Time or sequence label as written; dates are redacted in the event packets
Time or sequence label as written

matched_rule_ids.description: IDs from the provider's criteria this problem touches, for example INT-E1 or GI-X1

PageRow.description: What is on one page of the packet. Built first so the extractor and the people can navigate.

basis.description: One or two sentences on why, in plain language

confirmed_by.description: Role of the person who confirmed, if any

RuleResult.description: The result of checking one rule against the SST.

provider_id.description: Which provider's requirements were applied, for example ihh

hard_stops.description: Rule IDs that are not_met and exclude on their own

coordinator_decision.description: The human decision. The tool recommends; the coordinator decides.

Eligibility.description: Computed by the provider's requirements profile. Never extracted from the packet directly.

readiness.description: 0 to 100. How ready this packet is to be decided by this provider: completeness, rule coverage, rules met, arrangements confirmed. Not a probability of approval. Hard stops are shown separately and are never averaged in.

completeness.description: Checklist documents present out of those this packet needs

rule_coverage.description: Applicable rules that can be answered from the record

rules_met.description: Of the answerable rules, how many are met

arrangements.description: Conditional rules whose arrangement is confirmed

hard_stop_count.description: Number of exclude rules that are met. Any value above 0 sets the band to blocked_by_hard_stop

weights.description: Weights used, from the provider profile. Sum to 1

explanation.description: Two or three plain sentences the coordinator can read out, naming the biggest reason the score is not 100

top_actions.description: Up to three actions that would raise readiness the most, each tied to a gap id

Scores.description: A readiness score, computed deterministically from the rule results. Explains itself. Never shown to the patient.

what.description: What is missing or unclear, in plain language

draft_request_text.description: Draft wording for the hospital. Drafted only; nothing is sent by the tool.

Gap.description: One thing to ask the hospital (or the patient) for while the patient is still in the hospital.

language.description: Language the summary is written in

requires_staff_review.description: True until a staff member has read it

where_things_stand.description: Two or three plain sentences. No medical advice.

PatientSummary.description: What the patient sees. Status and logistics only; clinical interpretation stays with staff.

actor_label.description: Display label, never a real name in the event build

HistoryRow.description: One change. The SST is append-only in history.

consent_confirmed.description: Every participant agreed to the recording or dictation before it started. Required true before any transcript is stored. California requires all-party consent for recorded calls.

transcript_text.description: The transcript, with speaker labels by role. Identifier scrub runs before storage

identifier_scrub.description: Result of the check for names, dates of birth, phone numbers and record numbers

summary.description: Three to five plain sentences: what was asked, what was promised, by when

proposed_value.description: As text; the field's own type applies once accepted

items.description: A fact said in the conversation that could update the SST. Nothing changes until a person accepts it.

extracted_items.description: Proposed SST updates from this conversation

ConversationRow.description: One coordination conversation: a call with the hospital case manager, or a conversation with the patient. Transcribed, summarized, and mined for proposed SST updates that a person accepts or rejects.

unknowns.description: Things the question needed that the record does not contain

AnalysisRow.description: One read-only analysis. Analyses never change the SST; they read it and cite it.
